content: Jerusalem ah Thu Kikupna
Judah ngam pan hongpai mi pawlkhat te in, Moses thukham bang in vunteap na tan bua uh le, ngupna nga thei ngawl tu nu hi, ci in suapui te hil uh hi.

Amate Paul le Barnabas taw thu kisik ngawl na le ki nial na nasia mama nei uh ahikom in, Antioch a om pawlpi te in Paul, Barnabas le mi pawlkhat te hi thudokna taw kisai Jerusalem ah sawltak te le upa te kungah then tu in khensat uh hi.
Pawlpi in lamkal ah amate tha uh a, Phoenicia le Samaria kantan in pai hi, taciang Gentile te i kikhealna thu pualak uh hi: taciang suapui te theampo nasiatak in lungdamsak uh hi.
Amate Jerusalem a thet uh ciang in pawlpi, sawltak te le upa te in muak uh a, Pathian in amate tungtawn a vawt nate theampo son uh hi.
Ahihang Pharisee te sungpan thu um pawlkhat te in Gentile thu umte sia vunteap tan kul a, Moses thukham zong zui tu in thupiak kul hi, ci uh hi.
Taciang hi thu ngaisun khawm tu in sawltak te le upa te munkhat ah ki kaikhawm uh hi.

Thu tampi a ki nial zawk uh ciang, Peter ding a, amate tung ah, u le nau te awng, Gentile mite in keima kam pan in lungdamna thupha za uh a, a up theina tu in, tuma hiat in Pathian in eite sung pan keima hong teal hi, ci na he uh hi.
Taciang thinsung a he Pathian in tettipang a, eite tungah hongpiak bang in amate zong Tha Thiangtho pia hi;
Taciang eite le amate kilaklaw ah ki bat ngawlna bangma koi ngawl a, upna tungtawn in amate thinsung te thiangthosak hi.
Tua ahikom, tu in, i pu le pa te le eite in zong i puak zawk ngawl hakkol sia nungzui te ngawng ah koi in banghang Pathian ze-et nu ziam?
Ahihang Topa Jesus Christ i thuthiamna tungtawn in amate ngupna a nga uh bangma in eite zong i nga tu hi, ci in ka um hi, ci hi.
Tuazawkciang in Paul le Barnabas te in Gentile te sungah Pathian in amate zang in a vawt nalamdang tatuam te a son uh ciang in, mihon pi te in thim khipkhep in ngai uh hi.
Amate thim khipkhep in a om zawk uh ciang in, James in, u le nau te awng, hong ngai tavun:
Ama min atu mi teal tu in Pathian in amasabel in Gentile mite tungah a pai na thu Simon in hong pualak zo hi.
Taciang hi thu sia kamsang te kammal in zong lungkim uh a,
Hi thu zawkciang in kong paikik tu a, a puksa David i biakbuk ka sa kik tu hi; taciang a lal sa sia kasakik tu a, ka dingsak kik tu hi:
Tabang in a tanglai mihing te le Ama min taw a sap Gentile te theampo in Topa zong tu uh hi, ci in hi thu te theampo a vawt Topa in ci hi.
Pathian in leitung piancil pan in a nasep theampo he siat hi, ci ki at zo hi.
Tua ahikom keima i thukhenna sia, Gentile mite sung pan in Pathian sangah a kihei te nawngkaisak bua tawng:
Ahihang milim taw in a thiangtho ngawl te, paktat mawna, tawlsan in a kithat sa te le thisan te pial tu in lai kong thak zaw hi.
Banghangziam cile Moses i thukham sia nidang pek pan in khua tatuam ah ki hil a, synagogue te sung zong ah sabbath nisim in ki sim tawntung hi, ci hi.
Gentile Thu Um Mite Laithak

Tuazawkciang in amate sung pan in a tealsa te, suapui te sungah a thupibel Judah a kici Barsabas le Silas te sia, Paul le Barnabas te taw Antioch ah paisak tu in, sawltak te le elder te pan kipan pawlpi buppi in lungkim uh hi:
Taciang amate in hibang in laithak at uh a, sawltak te, elder te le suapui te in Antioch, Syria le Cilicia a om Gentile suapui te hong paupui khu hi:

Kote kung pan in mi pawlkhat te note kungah hongpai uh a, koma thupiak hi ngawl napi, vunteap na tan hamtang uh kul hi, ciang thukham zong na zui hamtang uh kul hi, ci in hong sawl na kammal in note hong nawngkaisak a, na nuntakna uh hong susia hi, ci thu ka za uh hi:
Munkhat ah thu kisi in omkhawm tek a, ka teal uh mihing te, ka it mama uh Barnabas le Paul taw note kungah kong paisak tu uh pha ka sa uh hi.
Amate sia i Topa Jesus Christ min atu in a nuntakna dong a pia ngam te a hi uh hi.
Tua ahikom Judah le Silas te kong paisak uh a, lai kong thak uh bangma in amate in a kam uh taw hongson tu uh hi.
Banghangziam cile note tungah hi a kisam nate simngawl a lianzaw vanngit kong sot ngawl tu uh sia Tha Thiangtho le kote in pha kasa uh hi;

Tabang in note in milim tungah na piak uh sa te, thisan, tawlsan in a kingo sa te le paktat mawna te pial vun: tabang te pan in noma le noma na ki keamcing uh le, a pha ngamta na hi uh hi. Na damtek tavun, ci in laithak at uh hi.
Tua ahikom amate a paikhiat uh ciang in Antioch theng uh hi: mihon te munkhat ah a ki kaikhop zawk uh ciang in, laithak sia pia uh hi:
Tua laithak a sim zawk uh ciang in, henepna thu ahikom in lungdam mama uh hi.
Taciang Judah le Silas te zong kamsang te ahi uh bangma in, suapui te thu tampi taw hanthawn uh a, kipsak uh hi.
Tua mun ah tawlkhat sung a om zawk uh ciang in, suapui te kung pan sawltak te kungah thinnuam takin paisak uh hi.
Ahihang Silas sia tua mun ah om nuam lai hi.
Paul le Barnabas te Antioch ah omsuak a, midang tampi te taw Topa thuhil in tangko uh hi.
Paul le Barnabas Kikhen
Tawlkhat sung zawkciang in, Paul in Barnabas kungah, Topa thu i hil na uh mun khua tatuam ah suapui te ve tu in paikik tawng, bangbang in om ziam, ci en tawng, ci hi.
Taciang Barnabas in Mark a kici John sia amate taw tonpui tu in ngaisun hi.
Ahihang Paul in Pamphylia pan in amate taw kikhen a, nasep na mun ah a pai ngawl hu in, amate taw tonpui tu phangawl hi, ci ngaisun hi.
Tua thu Paul le Barnabas nasiatak in ki nial uh a, khat le khat kikhen uh hi: taciang Barnabas in Mark tonpui a, Cyprus sangah tembaw taw pai hi;
Taciang Paul in Silas teal a, suapui te i Pathian thuthiamna sungah apna taw in pai uh hi.
Taciang Syria le Cilicia ngamsung theampo ah pai kakoai uh a, pawlpi te kipsak uh hi.
